label: CJ Affiliate
terms_note: API access uses a personal access token issued in the CJ account (developer portal opened, terms not read).

discovery.auth: token (CJ Developer Portal personal access token; GraphQL + REST)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (advertiser reporting / commission APIs on the CJ Developer Portal; content unreadable this pass) Confidence: **medium**.
reference.limits: - Contract-based; API terms on the portal.

fields.name: personal_access_token
fields.help: CJ Developer Portal personal access token (https://developers.cj.com/account/personal-access-tokens), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`; it must belong to a user of the advertiser company (CID) queried.

config_fields.name: company_id
config_fields.help: The advertiser's CJ company id (CID); used by the `me` probe (get_report takes it as account_id).

me.note: There is no account query; the probe is the Commission Detail advertiserCommissions query for the configured CID with no dates (CJ defaults to the last 24 hours by posting date), returning {data: {advertiserCommissions: {count, payloadComplete}}}. GraphQL failures come back as {data: null, errors: [...]}.

body.query: =query($advertisers: [String!]!, $since: String, $before: String) { advertiserCommissions(forAdvertisers: $advertisers, sincePostingDate: $since, beforePostingDate: $before) { count payloadComplete maxCommissionId records { commissionId orderId postingDate eventDate actionStatus actionType actionTrackerName publisherId publisherName websiteName original saleAmountAdvCurrency advCommissionAmountAdvCurrency cjFeeAdvCurrency pubCommissionAmountUsd } } }

get_report.note: Commission Detail API (POST https://commissions.api.cj.com/query, GraphQL) advertiserCommissions for account_id (the advertiser CID) posted from date_from 00:00Z up to (excluding) date_to 00:00Z; at most 31 days per call. Rows are individual commission records, not aggregates: `spend` is the advertiser commission and `cj_fee` the CJ fee, both in the advertiser's currency; corrections are separate delta records (original=false) to be summed with the original. At most 10,000 records per call; when payloadComplete is false, more exist (cursor paging by maxCommissionId is not followed). `campaign_id` is not applied (CJ has no campaigns). A GraphQL error answers {data: null, errors} and yields no rows. Limit: 200 calls per 5 minutes.

not_offered.list_accounts: The token is user-level and no GraphQL or REST API lists the advertiser companies a user can access (Commission Detail takes forAdvertisers CIDs; the Advertiser Lookup REST API is a publisher-side lookup of advertiser programs, https://developers.cj.com/docs/rest-apis/advertiser-lookup).
not_offered.list_campaigns: CJ programs have no campaign objects in the API; the GraphQL APIs are Commission Detail, Item List, Product Feed, Program Terms, Promotional Properties and Tech Partner (https://developers.cj.com/graphql).
not_offered.update_budget: No budget API: CJ is pay-per-action and the developer portal documents no budget endpoint (https://developers.cj.com/graphql).
not_offered.pause_resume: No program or campaign status endpoint in the developer portal's GraphQL or REST APIs (https://developers.cj.com/graphql).

evidence: probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: get_report:variables, me:variables
